CARC_97.standard_description: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service/procedure that has already been adjudicated.
CARC_97.remedy: Reallocate from Patient Responsibility (PR) to Contractual Obligation (CO). Under CMS guidelines and commercial in-network provider contracts, unbundled component services cannot be balance-billed to the patient.
CARC_97.statutory_citation: CMS Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, Chapter 23 § 20.9; ERISA § 503 (29 U.S.C. § 1133)

CARC_45.standard_description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
CARC_45.remedy: In-network provider write-off required under participating provider agreement. Balance billing the member for amounts exceeding contracted fee schedule is prohibited by law.
CARC_45.statutory_citation: 45 CFR § 149.30 (No Surprises Act); Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act § 2719A

CARC_16.standard_description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s).
CARC_16.remedy: Administrative provider deficiency. Patient cannot be billed for provider technical billing omission.
